title: Optimal error bounds on the exponential integrator for dispersive equations with highly concentrated potential
summary: We study a one-dimensional linear dispersive equation of differential order $κ\geq 2$ with concentrated potential of extension $\varepsilon$ with $0 < \varepsilon \ll 1$, featuring a competition between weak dispersion of strength $\varepsilon^α\ (0 \leq α\leq κ)$ and localization induced by the concentrated potential. We first obtain precise regularity estimates of the exact solution in terms of $\varepsilon$.
